SipPulseAiApiKey.title: SipPulse AI API key (notes)
SipPulseAiApiKey.description: Required. SipPulse AI key; covers live transcription (pulse-stt-streaming-v1, pt-BR) and meeting notes. Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key with a spending limit.

EndpointUrl.title: vCon store endpoint
EndpointUrl.description: Required. HTTPS URL of the vCon store that receives the final vCon (SipPulse: https://crm.sippulse.com/api/vcons/ingest).

HmacSecret.title: vCon store HMAC secret
HmacSecret.description: Required. The vCon store's shared secret (SipPulse CRM: VCON_HMAC_SECRET). Every delivery is signed with X-MeetVcon-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body>.

SipPulseAiUrl.title: SipPulse AI base URL (notes)
SipPulseAiUrl.description: Optional. HTTPS base of the SipPulse AI API. Defaults to https://api.sippulse.ai.

AllowedEmailDomains.title: Allowed collaborator email domains
AllowedEmailDomains.description: Optional. Chrome profile email domains allowed to capture, e.g. ["sippulse.com"]. Unset, any signed-in profile may capture.

AnalysisMode.title: When to analyse the conversation
AnalysisMode.description: Optional. final (default) runs the notes and the TypeSafe classification once, when the call ends. live also runs them during the call: notes every minute and a tag per line, at a higher cost.

TypeSafeUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
TypeSafeUrl.description: Optional. HTTPS base of TypeSafe (.../v1/systemone) to classify intent, sentiment and action items. No default: classification is off unless set.

CaptureEnabled.title: Enable meeting capture
CaptureEnabled.description: Optional kill switch. Defaults to enabled.
